name: Ryan Machando
title: Software Engineering Graduate
bio: Software Engineering graduate with a strong foundation in full-stack development, database design, and algorithm implementation. I build web applications from concept to deployment and have hands-on experience with AI concepts including genetic algorithms and neural networks.

education.details: Key modules: Database Principles, Artificial Intelligence, Networks, Data Structures & Algorithms, Complex Problem Solving.

achievements: Coordinated with a team to organize and run career events for students, working with over 50 companies to ensure smooth logistics and communication.
Conducted drop-in sessions to assist students with CVs and cover letters, offering personalized feedback to up to 30 students a day.
Demonstrated strong communication and teamwork skills while supporting students in identifying job opportunities.
Collaborated with a team to assist prospective students applying to the university through the clearing process.
Processed student applications, ensuring accuracy and adherence to university guidelines.
Co-ordinated decision making and offer processing, requiring analytical thinking and organisational skills.
Facilitated communication with applicants — providing timely updates, resolving queries, and guiding individuals through the clearing process.

projects.name: Automated Study Assistant
projects.subtitle: Final Year Project
projects.description: Full-stack web app that processes user-uploaded study notes using rule-based NLP (spaCy) to automatically generate flashcards and multiple-choice quizzes. Includes a progress-tracking dashboard that visualises quiz performance over time and surfaces priority revision topics — differentiating it from tools like Anki and Notability.

projects.name: AI Spider Kinematics Optimisation
projects.subtitle: Group Project
projects.description: Engineered a Genetic Algorithm to evolve optimal joint configurations for a spider model — involving chromosome encoding, fitness function design, and mutation operators. Trained a Feedforward Neural Network to predict valid joint angles, managing the full ML pipeline from data preparation to model training and performance visualisation.

projects.name: Python Voice Assistant
projects.subtitle: Personal Project
projects.description: Interactive voice assistant capable of real-time speech processing and task execution. Integrated the ElevenLabs Conversational AI API for end-to-end voice processing, including speech recognition, LLM response generation, and text-to-speech synthesis. Includes system command execution and web search based on voice input.

projects.name: Resource Allocation Tool
projects.subtitle: Group Project
projects.description: Collaborated in an agile team to build an automated tool for optimizing project resource allocation based on team member availability and skill alignment. Contributed to a clean, intuitive UI and worked on optimizing the core allocation algorithm for scalability and efficiency.

projects.name: Race Timer Web Application
projects.subtitle: Coursework
projects.description: Architected a real-time timing system designed to handle 500+ concurrent inputs, with a strong emphasis on fault tolerance and data integrity. Implemented race timer initiation, offline data recording, and batch upload — under the constraint of no third-party libraries.
